# Office of the Historian - U.S. Department of State

> > Official archive of U.S. foreign policy history through the Foreign Relations of the United States (FRUS) series, documenting diplomatic correspondence, declassified documents, and historical research from the Civil War to the Cold War era.

The Office of the Historian maintains the authoritative documentary record of American diplomacy, including declassified materials on arms control, Cold War policy, presidential decision-making, and bilateral relations. The site serves historians, researchers, and policymakers with primary sources spanning from 1861 to the late 20th century.

## Key Topics

- Foreign Relations of the United States (FRUS)
- Declassification and Historical Review
- Cold War Diplomacy
- Arms Control and Disarmament
- National Security Council
- UN Commission for Conventional Armaments
- Presidential Foreign Policy
- Vietnam War
- Soviet-American Relations
- Historical Advisory Committee
- Diplomatic Correspondence
- Civil War Diplomacy
- Covert Operations
- Bilateral Relations
- Neutrality and Trade Policy

## Cold War and National Security Policy

- [1967 Fortas Memo on Vietnam War Bombing Policy](https://history.state.gov//historicaldocuments/frus1964-68v05/d387fn3): 1967 Fortas memo to LBJ on Vietnam War bombing policy & public opinion
- [State-CIA Relations and Covert Operations](https://history.state.gov//historicaldocuments/frus1964-68v33/d261fn6): 1960s doc on State-CIA relations & covert operations coordination
- [1963 NSC Memo on Philippines Relations](https://history.state.gov//historicaldocuments/frus1961-63v23/d387fn1): 1963 NSC memo: Forrestal to Kennedy on Philippines & Macapagal relations
- [1969 Kissinger Memo on Yemen Relations](https://history.state.gov//historicaldocuments/frus1969-76v24/d178fn4): 1969 Kissinger memo on Yemen diplomatic relations & US interests section

## Arms Control and Disarmament

- [1949 UN Commission for Conventional Armaments](https://history.state.gov//historicaldocuments/frus1949v01/d17fn2): 1949 FRUS doc on UN Commission for Conventional Armaments & verification
- [1949 UN Arms Control and Verification](https://history.state.gov//historicaldocuments/frus1949v01/d17fn4): 1949 FRUS doc on UN arms control & conventional armaments verification
- [1982 Law of the Sea Treaty Correspondence](https://history.state.gov//historicaldocuments/frus1981-88v41/d183fn3): 1982 Bremer-Clark correspondence on Law of the Sea treaty UN funding

## FRUS Series History and Declassification

- [1980 FRUS Re-Review and Declassification Reform](https://history.state.gov//historicaldocuments/frus-history/research/1980-rereview): Joshua Botts on 1980 FRUS re-review & declassification policy reform
- [The First FRUS Volume of 1861](https://history.state.gov//historicaldocuments/frus-history/research/marrs-on-the-first-volume): Aaron Marrs on first 1861 FRUS volume & Civil War diplomacy documentation
- [November 1980 Historical Advisory Committee Minutes](https://history.state.gov//historicaldocuments/frus-history/documents/1980-11-13-hac-meeting-minutes): Nov 1980 Historical Advisory Committee meeting minutes on FRUS series

## Bilateral Relations and Regional Policy

- [1954 Military Assistance to Colombia](https://history.state.gov//historicaldocuments/frus1952-54v04/d291fn3): 1954 State Dept memo on military assistance grant aid to Colombia
- [1939 Swiss Neutrality and Pre-WWII Trade](https://history.state.gov//historicaldocuments/frus1939v02/d837fn4): 1939 FRUS doc: Swiss Minister Peter on pre-WWII trade & neutrality
